description: Create a free Engagemii data account, or sign in to an existing one, with just an email address. There is no password: we send a one-click sign-in link (valid 30 days) to the address. When the user clicks it they are signed in and the address is verified, which activates the account's API key (edk_...). The key is then shown at https://engagemii.com/aeo/data/portal/api and unlocks search_companies and data_records. Use the email address the user gives you.

email.description: The user's email address. The sign-in link is sent here.
